usage.source_scope: Guardian UR5-Fail source-defined train/validation/test splits at pinned revisions; 400/30/140 execution rows and three start/end RealSense views.
usage.project_application: Endpoint execution-state recognition before HANDOFF_READY, with grounded local evidence separated from deterministic success/failure/UNKNOWN authority.
usage.modifications: Task-conditioned GroundingDINO task/gripper regions, global/task/interaction CLIP deltas, explicit region geometry, fixed 80-dimensional tensor, StandardScaler plus logistic regression, and alpha 0.2 split conformal reduction.
usage.expected_effect: Improve execution-state discrimination by tying visual changes to the manipulated entity and actuator rather than relying on a global frame delta.

evaluation.setup: Source-native 400 training and 30 validation rows fit/calibrated the frozen representation; 140 test rows remained outcome-invisible until provider seal. Both GroundingDINO and CLIP used measured CUDA backends without fallback.
evaluation.effect: Local carriers improved same-known balanced accuracy by 10.15 points at 76.43 percent coverage, but reached only 59.94 percent selective balanced accuracy and 57.14 percent failure recall, below the frozen gates.
evaluation.claim_boundary: SC46 shows a large relative execution-state gain from local carriers on one fresh real UR5 source, but misses absolute and per-class gates; no online identity, navigation, arrival, completion, product, or safety authority.

evidence.summary: Frozen SC46 source identities, truth firewall, local carrier representation, reducer, and gates.
SC46 metrics, backend and artifact hashes, error localization, and claim boundary.

history.change: Consumed SC46 test split: do not tune prompt, detector threshold, crop construction, classifier, conformal alpha, or gate. Next successor needs explicit object-state/change or contact/release evidence on a new frozen cohort.
